notes.title: Playtest Begins! First Look at The Boss Gangsters
notes.content:
[p]Hello Bosses,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife[/b] playtest is now live! 🎉[/p][p]We are aware that localization is still incomplete, so for the best experience we recommend playing in English for now.[/p][p]The purpose of this limited version is to test the game’s performance, gameplay feel, and overall experience.
Development is ongoing, and your feedback and suggestions will help us shape the roadmap of the game.[/p][p]We hope you’ll have fun and start building the best clubs in the city! 🏙️✨[/p][p]Thank you 🙌[/p][p]Please share your bug reports, suggestions, and feedback with us via our Steam Community page or Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tU70I__8EVY;full"][/previewyoutube]

Wanna join early? Hop into our [url="https://discord.gg/4CEwpYjxQy"]Discord[/url] and don’t miss your chance![/p][p]🔥 More updates and reveals are coming.
[b]Stay tuned, Bosses![/b][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Bosses,

We’re coming to you with great news!
The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife will soon be available in Early Access. Here's an update on our current progress and what’s to come:

[b]Open World – Night City[/b]

[list]
[*] The full potential of an open world is now part of our game.
[*] Rival gangs, illegal drug and weapon trafficking, human smuggling, money laundering, and much more await you.
[*] Open-world missions will challenge you while running your club, and sometimes offer moments of pure fun.
[*] Meet the Big Boss! At the beginning of the game, he’ll guide you through the world and help you learn the ropes with hands-on experience.
[*] Capos and Gangsters: You’re no longer alone in this city. Capos will be your right-hand, while gangsters will bring the firepower.
[*] Build your family, meet new people, and become the true ruler of the city.
[*] As you manage your club, you’ll rise in reputation and gain access to the criminal underworld.
[*] Vehicles are now in the game — choose based on speed and cargo capacity to suit your needs.
[*] With weekly events, you’ll unlock the dark world of crime — become rich or lose everything.
[/list]

[b]Manage Your Club Carefully[/b]

Make sure your employees are well-trained and have the right skills.

Be selective with your customers.

Keep an eye on those who get too drunk — they can be trouble.

Lap dance rooms and many other upgrades will be available in your club.

Security is crucial. Rival gangs may attack you — but of course, you can strike back...

After a long journey, we’re finally approaching the Early Access phase.
Stay tuned for the upcoming beta testing announcements — you won’t want to miss it!

[url=https://discord.gg/4CEwpYjxQy]TBG Nigthlife Discord[/url]

Brand new screenshots from The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife are now live on our Steam page!

Take a peek at the gritty streets, nightclubs, and the rising empire waiting for you in Night City.
Your underworld journey is about to begin...

notes.title: The Boss Gangsters : Nightlife Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello bosses, first of all, we would like to express our sincere thanks for the attention you have shown. We have released an update for The Boss Gangsters: Nightlife demo based on the feedback we received from you during the Steam Next Fest.

[list]
[*]Several errors in the tutorial have been corrected.Tutorial is now more stable.
[*]Camera angles have been fixed. Now, you can play the game with a downward angle
[*]Drink sale prices have been corrected.
[*]Waiter order taking and delivery points have been rearranged
[*]The issue of remaining glasses on the table has been resolved.
[*]Now, the wholesaler where you can order drinks will refresh its inventory of available drinks every day.
[*]Building menu: To perform move and sell actions, you need to close the shop
[*]The placement of warning pop-ups has been changed, and their duration has been increased
[*]The issue of customers stacking up at the same table consecutively has been fixed.
[/list] 

If you encounter any bugs or would like to share your thoughts, you can join our Discord through the following link.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/FNfjDUKnCa]Our Discord[/url]
